messages.subject: Has anyone tried to install PyStan on Comet cluster?  -Wstrict-prototypes invalid
parts:
Hi Everyone,

I am trying to install PyStan on XSEDE clusters, I did it on STAMPEDE and other clusters, but I could not install it on Comet.

1st, module load python..................... to load python2.7

2nd, export PYTHONPATH=$PYTHONPATH:/home/jeffdu/lib/python3.5/site-packages/

3rd, clone pystan repository from github: git clone –recursive https://github.com/stan-dev/pystan.git

4th, install pystan locally: python setup.py install --user

Below, the errors I got when installing:

creating build/temp.linux-x86_64-2.7
creating build/temp.linux-x86_64-2.7/pystan
creating build/temp.linux-x86_64-2.7/pystan/stan
creating build/temp.linux-x86_64-2.7/pystan/stan/src
creating build/temp.linux-x86_64-2.7/pystan/stan/src/stan
creating build/temp.linux-x86_64-2.7/pystan/stan/src/stan/lang
creating build/temp.linux-x86_64-2.7/pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars
compile options: '-DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -DEIGEN_NO_DEBUG -Ipystan/stan/src -Ipystan/stan/lib/stan_math_2.8.0/ -Ipystan/stan/lib/stan_math_2.8.0/lib/eigen_3.2.4 -Ipystan/stan/lib/stan_math_2.8.0/lib/boost_1.58.0 -I/opt/python/include/python2.7 -c'
extra options: '-O0 -ftemplate-depth-256 -Wno-unused-function -Wno-uninitialized'
Warning: Can't read registry to find the necessary compiler setting
Make sure that Python modules _winreg, win32api or win32con are installed.
gcc: pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/expression_grammar_inst.cpp
cc1plus: warning: command line option '-Wstrict-prototypes' is valid for C/ObjC but not for C++
gcc: pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/bare_type_grammar_inst.cpp
cc1plus: warning: command line option '-Wstrict-prototypes' is valid for C/ObjC but not for C++
gcc: pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/whitespace_grammar_inst.cpp
cc1plus: warning: command line option '-Wstrict-prototypes' is valid for C/ObjC but not for C++
gcc: pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/statement_2_grammar_inst.cpp
cc1plus: warning: command line option '-Wstrict-prototypes' is valid for C/ObjC but not for C++
gcc: pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/program_grammar_inst.cpp
cc1plus: warning: command line option '-Wstrict-prototypes' is valid for C/ObjC but not for C++
gcc: pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/ast_def.cpp
cc1plus: warning: command line option '-Wstrict-prototypes' is valid for C/ObjC but not for C++
gcc: pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/var_decls_grammar_inst.cpp
cc1plus: warning: command line option '-Wstrict-prototypes' is valid for C/ObjC but not for C++
virtual memory exhausted: Cannot allocate memory
cc1plus: warning: command line option '-Wstrict-prototypes' is valid for C/ObjC but not for C++

virtual memory exhausted: Cannot allocate memory
error: Command "gcc -pthread -fno-strict-aliasing -g -O2 -DNDEBUG -g -fwrapv -O3 -Wall -Wstrict-prototypes -fPIC -DBOOST_RESULT_OF_USE_TR1 -DBOOST_NO_DECLTYPE -DBOOST_DISABLE_ASSERTS -DEIGEN_NO_DEBUG -Ipystan/stan/src -Ipystan/stan/lib/stan_math_2.8.0/ -Ipystan/stan/lib/stan_math_2.8.0/lib/eigen_3.2.4 -Ipystan/stan/lib/stan_math_2.8.0/lib/boost_1.58.0 -I/opt/python/include/python2.7 -c pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/var_decls_grammar_inst.cpp -o build/temp.linux-x86_64-2.7/pystan/stan/src/stan/lang/grammars/var_decls_grammar_inst.o -O0 -ftemplate-depth-256 -Wno-unused-function -Wno-uninitialized" failed with exit status 1



I know it's Saturday, people should take a break till Monday, any suggestions are welcome!

Thanks and best!
Jeff
